info.name: In Search of the Ultimate Weapon

descriptions.notStarted: You look into the Mirror of Desire. There's a split second when you think you've lost your mind, but then… Where are you? Are you in the past? This feels like deja vu. You remember this, from a long, long time ago, when you begged #b#p1203000##k to make you the best polearm in the world.
descriptions.inProgress: When you ask #p1203000# for the best polearm available, #p1203000# takes a  long look at you and says you'll need to prove your worth. Your mission is to battle the  #r#o9001012#s and defeat them. You also have to gather #b#t4032311#s#k.
descriptions.completed: You managed to gather all the #t4032311#s required. #p1203000# liked you fearless attitude, and handed you the  polearm wrapped in cloth. The polearm, #p1201002#, and… Unfortunately, that was the extent of your memories.
